name: M3_PPS370MI_AddLine
description: Create batch purchase order lines and batch records that later add lines to existing purchase orders. This operation works within purchase order batch entry, using the message number to group all records that belong together. It can attach a line to an existing batch purchase order header, create both a new batch header and its first line in one step, or create a batch record that will add a line to an already existing purchase order when the batch is processed. The response returns the purchase order number and line sequence assigned to the batch line, which you then use for follow‑up actions such as adding charges, addresses, texts, or accounting information through other batch operations.
